description.content:
The Lemon Squeezy API is a REST API based on the JSON:API specification for managing a merchant-of-record store - stores, products, variants, prices, orders, customers, subscriptions, license keys, checkouts, discounts, and webhooks. Base URL https://api.lemonsqueezy.com/v1. Bearer API key auth with application/vnd.api+json headers.
